counterevidence: One router is a small and unrepresentative slice of inference: it carries no first-party API traffic, its list composition changes week to week, and a model leaving the list looks like a fall in volume.
definition: Doubling time of the tokens routed to the models on OpenRouter's public rankings, summed across the list at each snapshot. Derived metric routed_tokens_doubling_days.
name: Growth in tokens routed through a public router
timing_rationale: Coincident: routed volume moves as the work moves, with no reporting lag beyond the router's own window.
unpublished_reason: Waiting on history: the router's snapshots start in September 2026, and a growth fit on a few days of a trailing-window total would be noise. It publishes once eight weeks of snapshots exist.
why_it_matters: Every other adoption series counts people or accounts. This one counts work: how many tokens are actually being run, and how fast that is growing.
